property_summary: After initializing the contract, setting MinSum to 10, user Alice sends 100 wei via Put(0) and then calls Collect(100); in P, Log is set to the LogFile contract, so Collect succeeds; in M, Log is set to address(0), so Collect reverts due to the failed external call.
change_summary: Replace LogFile(_log) with LogFile(address(0)) to always set Log to a zero address.
